name: xAI Chat
description: Chat with current xAI Grok models via the OpenAI-compatible xAI API. Grok 4.3 is the balanced default, 4.5 targets highest-quality work, and Grok Build is coding-specific.
creator: Covia

messages.description: Conversation messages array [{role, content}]. Used by the agent tool call loop.

model.description: Model name (grok-4.3 balanced, grok-4.5 quality, grok-build-0.1 coding).

systemPrompt.description: System prompt to set the AI's behaviour.

apiKey.description: xAI API key (resolved from secret store by default).

url.description: Base URL. Defaults to the xAI API endpoint.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (e.g. 0 for deterministic extraction); provider default when omitted

topP.description: Nucleus sampling top_p; provider default when omitted

responseFormat.description: Response format: 'json', 'text', or {name, schema} for structured output.

toolCalls.description: Tool call requests from the LLM
